{"jobs":[{"data":{"slug":"68196","language":"en-us","languages":["en-us"],"client_code":"zs","req_id":"68196","title":"Pharmaceutical Commercial Strategy & Market Access Associate Consultant","description":"

ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

 

Pharmaceutical Commercial Strategy & Market Access Associate Consultant

 

ZS's Strategy Insights and Planning teams partner with clients to solve complex business challenges through rigorous research, analytics, strategic thinking, and deep industry expertise. This team works closely with healthcare and life sciences clients across commercial strategy, marketing, market access, and value & access, helping clients translate insights into actionable strategies and business decisions.

What You’ll Do

  • Support commercial strategy, marketing, market access, and value & access engagements for healthcare and life sciences clients.
  • Apply structured problem-solving and critical-thinking skills to complex and often ambiguous client business challenges.
  • Conduct qualitative and quantitative research, market analysis, and secondary research to develop actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Support and manage day-to-day client project execution, including workplans, timelines, status updates, risks, issues, and deliverables.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for clients and build strong working relationships through regular client interaction.

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.

Atlassian unleashes the potential of every team. Our agile & DevOps, IT service management and work management software helps teams organize, discuss, and complete shared work. The majority of the Fortune 500 and over 300,000 companies of all sizes worldwide - including NASA, Audi, Kiva, Deutsche Bank and Dropbox - rely on our solutions to help their teams work better together and deliver quality results on time. Our products include Jira Software, Confluence and Jira Service Management.

Our Mid-Market sales team is responsible for managing a portfolio of mid-sized customers. This includes identifying cloud first sales opportunities and cross-sell and user expansion opportunities, nurturing customer relationships, and achieving revenue targets. We expect you to serve as a strong advocate for our customers by providing valuable feedback to our product and engineering teams, contributing to the enhancement of our customer experience. All of these responsibilities will be carried out in close collaboration with our Channel Partners, Product Specialists, Account Managers, and Solution Engineers. We share a commitment, as a TEAM, in guiding and aiding our customer’s deployment and utilisation of Atlassian at scale. However, above all we believe in the Atlassian values and use them as our compass as we continue to evolve our revolutionary sales model.

{"jobs":[{"jobId":"190d9476-13fe-4a13-9e31-ec907d51b006","slug":"endpoint-automation-engineer","title":"Endpoint Automation Engineer","commitment":"Employee, Full Time","team":"IT","location":"Amsterdam, The Netherlands","department":"Shared Services","description":{"body":["About the role 
We are looking for a hands-on Endpoint Automation Engineer to design, build and continuously improve the automation that powers our global endpoint environment. This is a cross-platform engineering role focused on making endpoint services scalable, secure, reliable and consistent across Windows, macOS, Linux and mobile devices. 
 
You will replace repetitive administration with reusable code, integrations and event-driven workflows. Working across endpoint management, identity, security, application delivery, observability and device lifecycle services, you will use the Microsoft technology stack as core platforms while creating automation that operates across a broader endpoint technology ecosystem. 
Engineering mindset 
Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a repetitive task, fragile hand-off or one-off script and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?” 
 
You should be comfortable investigating unfamiliar systems, working from API documentation and turning operational requirements into maintainable automation. Your designs account for failure, test before release, instrument what you build and favour reusable services over isolated scripts. You take ownership from design through operation, document your solutions and balance long-term engineering improvements with immediate business needs. 
 
What success looks like 
You will measurably reduce manual work, deployment lead time and configuration inconsistency across the endpoint estate. Provisioning, configuration, software delivery, patching, compliance and lifecycle processes will become increasingly automated, observable, auditable and recoverable. 
 
Over time, you will help establish a shared Endpoint Automation model in which cross-platform services are delivered through reusable code, APIs, pipelines and common engineering standards rather than only platform-specific administration."],"sections":[{"title":"What you'll do","items":[{"text":"Design and maintain automation frameworks for endpoint enrollment, provisioning, configuration, application delivery and retirement."},{"text":"Build reusable tools, services and workflows usi
